# Secrets stay private

Coding rule · `S0.4`

Secrets never leave .local/. Never copy passwords, tokens or API keys into brain/, workspace/, reports, test cases or commit messages. Never print them.

Part of [[Hubs/Coding rules|Coding rules]].
